searched: Fetched the Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago's own PDF press release announcing Larry Howai's appointment as Governor (https://www.central-bank.org.tt/cbtt_storage/2025/06/Latest-News-Appointment-of-Larry-Howai-Esquire-as-Governor-of-the-Central-Bank-of-Trinidad-and-Tobago.pdf), and the Ministry of Finance's own 'MOF Company and Statutory Board Listing' PDF (https://www.finance.gov.tt/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/MOF-Company-and-Statutory-Board-Listing.pdf) to settle First Citizens' ownership.

The other roles it names are Minister of Finance and the Economy, Chairman of the National Gas Company, and Chairman of the National Energy Corporation, all public.
next_step: Treat the First Citizens leg as closed and public. The only remaining route to a Trinidad record is a biography naming his pre-First Citizens employer, which the official release does not.
